entries.title: Recognize service work consistently
entries.description: Quotes and Jobs for custom work are now labelled “Service Work” throughout the app.

entries.title: Reuse existing part categories
entries.description: The New Part dialog now suggests categories already in the catalog while still allowing new ones.

entries.title: Reach every dialog action
entries.description: Dialog footers remain accessible on shorter screens and no longer overlap the scrollbar.

entries.title: See locked measurement units up front
entries.description: Parts with stock history now show their unit of measure as locked before you save. Imports also identify affected rows clearly.

entries.title: Track work across every department
entries.description: Record start and finish times and crews for every production department on a Job. Product pages now show build-time summaries for each department.

entries.title: Send complete purchase orders
entries.description: Purchase order PDFs now include Jedidiah’s registered business name, registration and VAT numbers, address, email, and cellphone number.
